quote:
The bamboo forest blooms untouched even as the nights of war ripple across its stems.  

In every tempested tide, the calm river remembers that water has no right to part its path but to flow.  

When a creature of the sea shadows a man's life for a single heartbeat, the fisherman learns that fear is merely a fleeting shadow.  

The mortal taste of blood, though sweet to the beast, cannot erase the echo of a fallen garden.  

A city that burns to ash still carries the fragrance of lotus blossoms, reminding us that honor lives even in ruin.  

The quiet of the mountain blurs the echo of a gunshot; yet the wind carries the memory of courage to all who listen.  

Knowing the weight of a fist does not teach the plight of the unarmed; wisdom moves like stone through sand.
